builtins.name: print
builtins.description: Writes the values to the output without a newline.

builtins.name: println
builtins.description: Writes the values to the output followed by a newline.

builtins.name: len
builtins.signature: len(x: string | T[] | tuple | map): int
builtins.description: Number of characters in a string, or of elements in an array, tuple or map.

builtins.name: str
builtins.description: Converts any value to its text form.

builtins.name: to_int
builtins.description: Parses a decimal integer; a runtime error if the text is not a number.

builtins.name: array
builtins.description: Creates an array of n copies of value (arrays and structs are copied, not shared).

builtins.name: inspect
builtins.description: A detailed, multi-line description of a value; structs are shown field by field with their types.

builtins.name: dump
builtins.description: Prints inspect(value) followed by a newline.

builtins.name: copy
builtins.description: An independent copy of a struct, array, tuple or map (nested values are copied too).

builtins.name: has
builtins.description: True if the map contains the key.

builtins.name: remove
builtins.description: Removes the key and its value from the map (nothing happens if the key is absent).

builtins.name: keys
builtins.description: The keys of a map as an array, in the order they were added.

builtins.name: values
builtins.description: The values of a map as an array, in the order their keys were added.

builtins.name: input
builtins.description: Writes the prompt (if any), then reads one line from the input and returns it without its line break; "" at the end of the input.

builtins.name: end_of_input
builtins.description: True if the input has no more lines to read.

builtins.name: substring
builtins.signature: substring(s: string, start: int, end: int): string
builtins.description: The characters from position start up to (not including) end.

builtins.name: trim
builtins.description: The text without spaces, tabs and line breaks at its start and end.

builtins.name: to_upper
builtins.description: The text with the letters a-z changed to A-Z.

builtins.name: to_lower
builtins.description: The text with the letters A-Z changed to a-z.

builtins.name: split
builtins.description: The pieces of the text between the separators (with separator "", the single characters).

builtins.name: join
builtins.description: The parts joined into one text, with the separator between them.

builtins.name: replace
builtins.signature: replace(s: string, old: string, new: string): string
builtins.description: The text with every occurrence of old replaced by new.

builtins.name: starts_with
builtins.description: True if the text begins with prefix.

builtins.name: ends_with
builtins.description: True if the text ends with suffix.

builtins.name: contains
builtins.description: True if the text contains the part, or the array contains the element.

builtins.name: index_of
builtins.description: The position of the first occurrence of the part or element, or -1 if there is none.

builtins.name: repeat
builtins.description: The text repeated n times.

builtins.name: reverse
builtins.description: A new text or array with the characters or elements in reverse order.

builtins.name: char_code
builtins.description: The Unicode code point of a one-character string.

builtins.name: from_char_code
builtins.description: The one-character string with the given Unicode code point.

builtins.name: is_int
builtins.description: True if to_int(s) would succeed.

builtins.name: first
builtins.description: The first element of a tuple.

builtins.name: second
builtins.description: The second element of a tuple.

builtins.name: swap
builtins.description: The pair with its two elements exchanged.

builtins.name: zip
builtins.description: Pairs the elements at the same positions (as many pairs as the shorter array has elements).

builtins.name: enumerate
builtins.description: Pairs every element with its position.

builtins.name: items
builtins.description: The entries of a map as (key, value) pairs, in the order they were added.

builtins.name: push
builtins.description: Adds the value to the end of the array.

builtins.name: pop
builtins.description: Removes the last element of the array and returns it.

builtins.name: insert
builtins.signature: insert(a: T[], index: int, value: T)
builtins.description: Inserts the value at the position (0 to len(a)); later elements move up.

builtins.name: remove_at
builtins.description: Removes the element at the position and returns it; later elements move down.

builtins.name: slice
builtins.signature: slice(x: string | T[], start: int, end: int): string | T[]
builtins.description: A new text or array with the characters or elements from start up to (not including) end.

builtins.name: concat
builtins.description: A new array with the elements of a followed by those of b.

builtins.name: sort
builtins.description: A new array with the elements in ascending order (ints or strings).

builtins.name: range
builtins.description: The numbers from start up to (not including) end.

builtins.name: sum
builtins.description: The sum of the numbers.

builtins.name: map
builtins.signature: map(a: T[], f: func(T): U): U[]
builtins.description: A new array with f applied to every element.

builtins.name: filter
builtins.signature: filter(a: T[], keep: func(T): bool): T[]
builtins.description: A new array with the elements for which keep returns true.

builtins.name: reduce
builtins.signature: reduce(a: T[], initial: A, f: func(A, T): A): A
builtins.description: Combines the elements from left to right: f(f(initial, a[0]), a[1]) ...

builtins.name: get
builtins.signature: get(m: {K: V}, key: K, default: V): V
builtins.description: The value stored for the key, or default if the map does not contain it.

builtins.name: args
builtins.description: The command-line arguments given to the program (thundervm program.thc a b c).

builtins.name: get_env
builtins.description: The value of an environment variable, or "" if it is not set.

builtins.name: run
builtins.description: Runs a command of the operating system's shell; its output becomes part of the program's output. Returns the exit status.

builtins.name: run_output
builtins.description: Runs a shell command and returns its exit status and its output.

builtins.name: read_file
builtins.description: The contents of a text file (a runtime error if it cannot be read).

builtins.name: write_file
builtins.description: Creates or overwrites a text file.

builtins.name: append_file
builtins.description: Adds text to the end of a file (creating it if necessary).

builtins.name: file_exists
builtins.description: True if a file or directory exists at the path.

builtins.name: remove_file
builtins.description: Deletes a file (nothing happens if it does not exist).

builtins.name: list_dir
builtins.description: The names of the entries in a directory, sorted.

builtins.name: current_dir
builtins.description: The program's working directory.

builtins.name: time
builtins.description: Seconds since 1 January 1970 (UTC).

builtins.name: clock_ms
builtins.description: Milliseconds since the program started (for measuring how long something takes).

builtins.name: sleep
builtins.description: Pauses the program for the given number of milliseconds.

builtins.name: date_time
builtins.description: The local date and time as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".

builtins.name: platform
builtins.description: The operating system: "linux", "windows", "macos" or "unknown".

builtins.name: exit
builtins.description: Ends the program immediately with the given exit status.

builtins.name: random_int
builtins.description: A random whole number from low to high (both included).

builtins.name: seed_random
builtins.description: Restarts the random numbers from a seed, so a program can repeat the same "random" sequence.

builtins.name: to_float
builtins.description: Parses a decimal number such as "2.5", or turns a whole number into a decimal; a runtime error if the text is not a number.

builtins.name: is_number
builtins.description: True if to_float(s) would succeed.

builtins.name: abs
builtins.description: The distance of the number from zero: abs(-3) is 3.

builtins.name: min
builtins.description: The smaller of two numbers (or the earlier of two texts).

builtins.name: max
builtins.description: The larger of two numbers (or the later of two texts).

builtins.name: round
builtins.description: The nearest whole number; a half is rounded away from zero.

builtins.name: floor
builtins.description: The largest whole number that is not greater than x.

builtins.name: ceil
builtins.description: The smallest whole number that is not less than x.

builtins.name: sqrt
builtins.description: The square root of x (a runtime error if x is negative).

builtins.name: pow
builtins.description: x raised to the power y.

builtins.name: exp
builtins.description: e raised to the power x.

builtins.name: log
builtins.description: The natural logarithm of x (a runtime error if x is not positive).

builtins.name: sin
builtins.description: The sine of an angle given in radians.

builtins.name: cos
builtins.description: The cosine of an angle given in radians.

builtins.name: tan
builtins.description: The tangent of an angle given in radians.

builtins.name: random
builtins.description: A random decimal from 0 (included) to 1 (excluded).

builtins.name: canvas
builtins.description: Sets the size of the drawing area in pixels and clears it to white (the default is 400 x 300).

builtins.name: clear
builtins.description: Fills the whole canvas with a color, removing everything drawn before.

builtins.name: pixel
builtins.signature: pixel(x: float, y: float, color: string)
builtins.description: Colors one pixel.

builtins.name: line
builtins.signature: line(x1: float, y1: float, x2: float, y2: float, color: string)
builtins.description: Draws a line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

builtins.name: rect
builtins.signature: rect(x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float, color: string)
builtins.description: Draws a filled rectangle whose top left corner is (x, y).

builtins.name: rect_outline
builtins.signature: rect_outline(x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float, color: string)
builtins.description: Draws the outline of a rectangle.

builtins.name: circle
builtins.signature: circle(x: float, y: float, radius: float, color: string)
builtins.description: Draws a filled circle around the centre (x, y).

builtins.name: circle_outline
builtins.signature: circle_outline(x: float, y: float, radius: float, color: string)
builtins.description: Draws the outline of a circle.

builtins.name: text
builtins.signature: text(x: float, y: float, message: string, color: string)
builtins.description: Writes text whose top left corner is at (x, y).

builtins.name: text_size
builtins.description: The height of the text that text() writes from now on, in pixels (default 16).

builtins.name: line_width
builtins.description: The width of lines and outlines drawn from now on, in pixels (default 1).

builtins.name: rgb
builtins.signature: rgb(red: int, green: int, blue: int): string
builtins.description: The color with these amounts of red, green and blue (each 0 to 255), e.g. "#ff8800".

builtins.name: frame
builtins.description: Shows the picture, then waits for the next frame of the animation (see frame_rate).

builtins.name: show
builtins.description: Shows the picture now, without waiting.

builtins.name: frame_rate
builtins.description: How many frames per second frame() shows (1 to 120, default 30).

builtins.name: key_pressed
builtins.description: The next key the user pressed ("left", "space", "a", ...), or "" if there is none.

builtins.name: key_down
builtins.description: True while the key is held down.

builtins.name: mouse_x
builtins.description: The x position of the mouse on the canvas.

builtins.name: mouse_y
builtins.description: The y position of the mouse on the canvas.

builtins.name: mouse_down
builtins.description: True while the mouse button is held down over the canvas.

builtins.name: format
builtins.description: Replaces each {} of the template with the next value; {x} writes a whole number in hexadecimal, {b} in binary. {{ and }} are literal braces.

builtins.name: hex
builtins.description: A whole number written in hexadecimal: hex(42) is "0x2a" (to_int reads it back).

builtins.name: bin
builtins.description: A whole number written in binary: bin(10) is "0b1010" (to_int reads it back).

opcodes.description: Stop the program.
Push a constant from the constant pool.
Push the boolean true.
Push the boolean false.
Discard the value on top of the stack.
Push the value of a local variable.
Pop a value into a local variable.
Push the value of a global variable.
Pop a value into a global variable.
Add two numbers (runtime error on overflow).
Subtract two numbers (runtime error on overflow).
Multiply two numbers (runtime error on overflow).
Divide two numbers (integers round toward zero; error if b is 0).
Remainder of integer division (runtime error if b is 0).
Negate a number.
Logical NOT of a boolean.
Join two strings.
Compare two values for equality.
Compare two values for inequality.
Less than (numbers or strings).
Less than or equal (numbers or strings).
Greater than (numbers or strings).
Greater than or equal (numbers or strings).
Continue execution at the target address.
Pop a boolean; jump to the target if it is false.
Call a function; its arguments become its first locals.
Call a built-in function.
Return the value on top of the stack to the caller.
Return to the caller without a value.
Pop n values and push an array containing them.
Read an array element or a string character.
Write an array element.
Duplicate the value on top of the stack.

opcodes.stack_effect: a b -> a b a b
opcodes.description: Duplicate the two values on top of the stack (used by a[i] += v).
Convert an integer to a decimal number.
Pop the field values (in declaration order) and push a new struct.
Replace a struct by the value of one of its fields.
Store a value in a field of a struct.
Pop n values and push a tuple containing them.
Replace a tuple by one of its elements.
Pop n key/value pairs and push a map containing them.
Push a function value: a reference to a function, which can be stored, passed and called.
Pop a function value and call it with the n arguments below it.
Call a function in a native library (import native).
Bitwise AND: each result bit is 1 where both operands have a 1.
Bitwise OR: each result bit is 1 where either operand has a 1.
Bitwise XOR: each result bit is 1 where the operands differ.
Shift the bits left by n (0..63); bits shifted out are lost.
Shift the bits right by n (0..63), keeping the sign (arithmetic).
Invert every bit of an integer (~a equals -a - 1).
